ValidationRule.description: Restric owner change manually by team members.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(OwnerId) && NOT(ISCHANGED(Sub_Status__c)) && NOT( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Escrow Letter Generated") || ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "QA De-Snagging Completed") || ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Mortgage Release Completed") ) && NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "HO Manager", $Profile.Name = "CRM Operations", $Profile.Name = "Finance Team", $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Permission.BypassValidationRule, ISPICKVAL($User.UserType, 'AutomatedProcess') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the owner of this record.
